text.tspan: • Nearly unlimited API calls per second, per action
• Best-effort ordering: can arrive out of order
• Use when throughput matters and the app
• First In First Out: processed in order
in order inside one group, groups in parallel
batching (10 per call), per API action
• High-throughput mode: tens of thousands TPS
• "Order must be kept" or "no duplicates" → FIFO. "Highest throughput, order not important" → Standard.
• Order per customer/user but scale → FIFO with Message Group ID = customer id (one consumer per group at a time).
• You cannot convert a Standard queue to FIFO: create a new .fifo queue.
• S3 event notifications can't target a FIFO queue (Standard queues only).
